title: Prove complete T740 residual-phase identifiability
body:
PR3272 left open whether simultaneous changes at additional residual sites could preserve the T740 operator while redistributing rank. This package closes the complete fixed owner-0/port-0 residual interface: all twenty nonzero phase multipliers are uniquely recoverable from twenty entries of the eight-stream matrix, including the twelve currently empty residual sites.

The exact source replay produces 72 terms. A displayed rational inverse proves injectivity for arbitrary nonzero complex phases at each of all `2^73` characters; every denominator reduces to a nonzero monomial. Equality of phase functions then fixes each residual rank for independent replacement axes. An independent implementation reconstructs the context from raw authenticated JSON and certifies the inverse with separate arithmetic.

Validation: the complete registered replay passes on CPython 3.12.15, including both symbolic derivations and eight isolated optimized controls. Exact frozen-source replay agrees on five simultaneous 20-site perturbations. Metadata/pins pass. Reproduce with standard-library CPython 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t740-complete-phase-map
```

The proof fixes hosted prefixes, translations, stream charts and event order. It permits distinct bases with the same phase function and does not classify changed interfaces or other owners/ports. No native replay, selected cold replay, supplier admission or new kappa is claimed; selected and frozen inputs are unchanged.

Canonical coordination: [Discussion2612 comment19004159](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-19004159). Base canonical main/fork: `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`, priority revision 6. Builds on the five-site symbolic method in PR3272 (`2d349d6b8c26c308665f85222b447da07271e026`) and credits the retained provider/fill/word lineage, Gonzalo Mier's candidate replay and earlier four-site work, Tekalign, Nick Petalas and Ross Richardson's distinct absorption interface. Full attribution and exact source pins are in the package. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; separate AI executions are not independent human review. Apache-2.0.
